Privacy Policy

Last updated: May 2026

Precious Fix My Life ("we," "us," or "our") operates the website preciousfixmylife.com. This page informs you of our policies regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of personal data when you use our site and the choices you have associated with that data.

Information We Collect

We collect information you provide directly, such as your name and email address when you sign up for our free guide or make a purchase. We also collect usage data through cookies and analytics tools to understand how visitors use our site.

How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to deliver purchased ebooks, send requested email updates, improve our website, and market our products — which you can opt out of at any time.

Email Marketing

If you opt in to our email list, we may send you newsletters, promotions, and updates about our books. You can unsubscribe at any time via the link in every email or by contacting us directly.

Third-Party Services

We use Gumroad for payment processing and ebook delivery, ConvertKit for email marketing, and Stripe for payment processing. Each of these services has its own privacy policy. We encourage you to review their policies.

Cookies

We use cookies to track website usage and improve your experience. You can disable cookies in your browser settings.

Data Security

We take reasonable measures to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.

Your Rights

You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. Contact us at hello@preciousfixmylife.com to exercise these rights.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.

Contact

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at hello@preciousfixmylife.com.
